title: Synthetic social data: trials and tribulations

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to simulate respondents from four different countries (Argentina, USA, UK, China) using translated World Values Survey questions and comparing the synthetic responses against ground-truth human survey data using ANOVA and post-hoc tests.

Conditioning LLMs on specific social classes and education levels within persona prompts to answer economic and societal survey questions, then comparing the distributional outputs to actual human survey data.

Including specific ages in LLM persona prompts to generate synthetic survey responses and evaluating their statistical alignment with real human responses from corresponding age brackets in the World Values Survey.
Assigning specific sexes to LLM personas and comparing the generated survey responses on societal and democratic values to actual human data from the World Values Survey.
